title: Sky Team
components: 4 Blue Pilot dice & 4 Orange Co-Pilot dice
Landing Gear, Flaps, and Brake markers
setup: Place the control board between both players. One player takes the Blue Pilot screen & dice; the other takes the Orange Co-Pilot screen & dice.
Choose an Airport approach card (start with Montreal - YUL) and place the Altitude marker on space 7.
Place traffic planes on the approach track according to the airport card instructions.
Set the tilt marker perfectly level on the center 0 space of the Horizon axis.
Place all 3 landing gear switches, 3 flap switches, and the brake marker in their starting upright positions.
procedure: Phase 1 - Strategy Briefing: Discuss general goals and strategy with your partner. Once dice are rolled, absolutely NO verbal communication or gesturing is permitted!
Phase 2 - Roll Dice: Both players roll their 4 dice behind their respective screens.
Phase 3 - Dice Placement: Alternating one at a time, each player places 1 die onto an unoccupied cockpit space:
Mandatory Space A (Axis): Both Pilot and Co-Pilot must place 1 die on the Axis. The difference tilts the plane left or right.
Mandatory Space B (Engines): Both Pilot and Co-Pilot must place 1 die on the Engines. The sum determines if your plane advances 0, 1, or 2 spaces down the approach track.

Optional Spaces: Deploy Landing Gear (Pilot only), Deploy Flaps (Co-Pilot only), Radio (remove traffic planes from the approach track), Coffee (create reroll modifier tokens), or Brakes (increase final landing braking power).
Phase 4 - Altitude Step: Descend the plane by 1 altitude level. Repeat until final approach.
endGame: Victory Condition: Complete all 7 altitude rounds and land safely at Altitude 0 with: horizon axis perfectly level, all 3 landing gears deployed, all 3 flaps deployed, no traffic planes on the runway, and engine speed less than or equal to active brakes.

Crash / Defeat Conditions: You crash immediately if: horizon tilts too far into the red, engine speed causes collision with a traffic plane, engine speed causes the plane to overshoot or stall, or required mandatory dice cannot be placed.
⚖️ Tie-Breaker: Pure cooperative game (mutual landing success or crash).
notes: Strict Silence Rule: As soon as dice hit the table behind screens, neither player may suggest moves, hint at dice values, or signal what they need.
Coffee Tokens: Spending 1 coffee token allows a player to adjust a die value by +1 or -1, or reroll unplaced dice.
Aerodynamics: Deploying flaps and landing gear increases drag, changing the speed threshold required to advance on the track.
